message.toybox.help.title: Realm Toybox v0.9.0-rc1 | Java 26.2
message.toybox.help.blast: • Blast I–III: ground impact explosions are raised above the block; incompatible with Multishot/Piercing
message.toybox.help.rift_shot: • Rift Shot: sneak at an 8–48 block impact; costs 2.5 hearts and has a 3s cooldown
message.toybox.help.springstep: • Leap I–III: hold jump while rising for a higher jump; release early for a short jump
message.toybox.help.jump_pad: • Jump Pad: place an iron weighted pressure plate on yellow glazed terracotta; step off onto normal ground to re-arm
message.toybox.help.grappling: • Grappling Hook: cast the dedicated fishing rod at a block; sneak to cancel
message.toybox.rift_shot.blocked: [Toybox] Rift Shot needs sneak, 8–48 blocks, clear arrival space, and no cooldown.
message.toybox.help.wingbound: • Wingbound Chestplate: combine a chestplate and elytra for armor and gliding
message.toybox.help.wind_bottle: • Wind Bottle: glass bottle + wind charge + feather
message.toybox.help.anvil: • Reset anvil cost: hold the item, prepare 1 amethyst shard and 5 levels, then use /trigger tb_anvil set 1
message.toybox.help.levels: • Enchantment caps: protection set/damage trio/power/impaling X; efficiency/density VII; unbreaking/fortune/looting V; breach IV
message.toybox.help.advanced_enchant: • Advanced enchanting: hold the item and an equal-level single-enchantment book, then use a powered enchanting table
message.toybox.help.alchemy: • Potion synthesis: hold one potion in each hand, carry the catalyst, then use a brewing stand; caps are V and 60 minutes
message.toybox.help.measure: • Measuring tape: start/end with /trigger tb_measure; also reports inclusive size, area, and safe volume
message.toybox.help.chalk: • Chalk: /trigger tb_chalk set 1..8 saves a slot; /trigger tb_chshow set 1..8 shows it for 5 seconds
message.toybox.help.soup: • Soup Pot: put 4 matching vanilla soups into a cauldron over a lit campfire with /trigger tb_soup set 1; serve with set 2 and remove with set 3
message.toybox.jump_pad.blocked: [Toybox] Jump Pad needs five clear blocks above it. Step off to re-arm it.

message.toybox.dev.client_test.title: [Toybox Test] Manual validation kit — use an empty inventory in a disposable world
message.toybox.dev.client_test.enchant: 1. Enchant: test sword in main hand + Sharpness V book off hand. Use V, VI, VII, VIII, IX books in order; before X remove one outer shelf to verify no-cost failure, restore it, then reach X.
message.toybox.dev.client_test.preserve: 2. At X verify Unbreaking III, name, lore, 37 damage, repair cost 17, and the test marker all survived.
message.toybox.dev.client_test.potency: 3. Run /function toybox:dev/client_test_potency, then combine the two TEST A potions. Expect Speed V, 30,000 ticks; level 74 remains.
message.toybox.dev.client_test.duration: 4. Run /function toybox:dev/client_test_duration, then combine the TEST B normal+splash pair. Expect splash Speed IV, 72,000 ticks; level 9 remains.
message.toybox.dev.client_test.union: 5. Combine the TEST C normal two-effect + lingering three-effect pair. Expect a lingering five-effect potion, all exact-budget resources and levels at zero, then throw it.
message.toybox.dev.client_test.reject: 6. Run /function toybox:dev/client_test_reject and combine the TEST D pair. Strong Turtle Master must fail with no consumption.
message.toybox.dev.client_test.cleanup_h: Cleanup: stand on the test enchanting table, then run /function toybox:dev/client_test_cleanup. Added XP and synthesized results are not removed or restored.
message.toybox.dev.client_test.no_rig: [Toybox Test] Stand directly on the test enchanting table and run cleanup again; tagged unused inputs were still removed.
message.toybox.dev.client_test.cleanup_d: [Toybox Test] Rig under your feet and tagged unused inputs removed. Added XP and synthesized results were left alone.
